# Tools for Conviviality

> An independent directory of small, convivial software, scored from 0 to 30 on six questions drawn from Ivan Illich's Tools for Conviviality: footprint, lock-in, self-direction, power, longevity and delivery.

## For AI agents

- [Build a more convivial tool: a prompt for coding agents](https://toolsforconviviality.com/for-agents/): audits a project against the six questions, proposes improvements, and changes nothing until the human approves.
- [Suggest or re-submit a tool](https://toolsforconviviality.com/suggest/): the form accepts prefilled values as URL parameters (name, url, what, size, scope, cat, price, source, img, data, rel, self, update).

## Key pages

- [How we score](https://toolsforconviviality.com/how-we-score/)
- [Directory and leaderboard, ranked by score](https://toolsforconviviality.com/directory/)
- [Benchmarks](https://toolsforconviviality.com/benchmarks/)
